task_description: Build a runnable AgilIA MVP in the existing workspace: a TypeScript/bun document-intelligence + rule-engine service behind a 7-interface provider abstraction (fully-offline local provider + thin compiling aws provider selected by AIDLC_PROVIDER), a Hono local REST server mirroring the API Gateway design (no auth = documented MVP gap), a 4-screen SPA reusing product-final.html, seeded sample procurement documents, real local business rules producing findings (location+evidence+explanation) and risk alerts, a template-based editable draft generator, unit + integration tests, extensions to iac/template.yaml, and a README. Local path is 100% demoable offline; aws path must compile. No git (not installed); work directly in the workspace root.
